stories.h: Feds buy Tacoma ICE detention center for $453 million
stories.s: DHS bought the 1,635-bed Northwest ICE Processing Center from GEO Group, which keeps running services under a 10-year contract. Reps. Randall and Jayapal question the price against a $72.6M assessment.

stories.h: Tacoma swap meet manager charged in stolen-goods ring
stories.s: Pierce County prosecutors charged a 58-year-old manager with leading organized crime, alleging she directed others to buy and resell stolen tools, sneakers, e-bikes and more from July to November.

stories.h: Five-year sentence in Puyallup WinCo stabbing, U-Haul chase
stories.s: Joshua Mineer, 41, was sentenced after pleading guilty to attempted assault, theft and eluding in a 2025 incident that included a box-cutter attack and a head-on crash.

coming.s: Tacoma's original Thanksgiving morning fun run starts at 9 a.m. at the Center at Norpoint in Northeast Tacoma.

coming.h: Zoolights opens at Point Defiance Zoo
coming.s: The holiday light show opens 4:30-10 p.m. and runs through Jan. 3; timed online tickets are required.
